messages.content: Please look up alice’s contact info, get the latest business news, and turn it into a high-priority Business Travel Briefing for email, then save that briefing as a document. Next, check the status of flight CA1234, prepare a business-class booking request for Alice Johnson, and book it if it’s available. After that, look up Hilton Tokyo, prepare an available deluxe-room stay request for Alice Johnson from 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12, and then get the hotel’s stay sheet and archive it as a high-priority Hotel Archive Packet for email.
